list: The official 55 trophies (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is written in our own words.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Work the roadmap in order — story, stranger arcs, collectibles, activities, then cleanup — and use the tracker on this page to see what is left. Nothing else is required.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission and unlocks as you play through the opening; it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock as the story advances; they cannot be missed, and missions can be replayed from the pause menu if you want to redo one.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Chapter trophies unlock as the story advances and cannot be missed; missions can be replayed from the pause menu.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Chapter trophies unlock as the story advances and cannot be missed; missions can be replayed from the pause menu.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Chapter trophies unlock as the story advances and cannot be missed; missions can be replayed from the pause menu.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. This is the gold story trophy; it unlocks when the credits roll. Before you start the finale, clear the missable stranger arcs first — see the roadmap.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Mission trophies unlock on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story. Mission trophies unlock on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the story. Mission trophies unlock on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners when it appears in the story. Mission trophies unlock on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story. Mission trophies unlock on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story. Mission trophies unlock on completion and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats. That means finishing the story, all stranger missions, collectibles, activities and the other completion categories the game tracks. This is the last gold to chase — clear every other category first, then check the in-game 100% stat to see what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count. Stunts build up naturally while driving; to grind them, take a fast car onto the highway and chain jumps and near misses. The game tracks your stunt count in the stats menu.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — fishing, shooting range, drone races, street races, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities. You only need to start each one once, not finish or win it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has several challenges, and gold means hitting its score or time target. Take your time on the timed ones, use a steady aim, and retry a challenge as often as needed — progress is saved per challenge.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location hosts its own race, and you must win at each one. Learn the course on a practice run first, then race to win — the drone handles like a light aircraft, so cut corners where the course allows.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street races, and each one must be a different race, not the same race 20 times. Enter races around Leonida and win each one once; the game counts distinct races won.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge; out-fish him by landing the bigger catch. If you lose, you can challenge him again.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, playing it through to the end. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the shortest game if you just want the trophy.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy's strand is a stranger arc — work through his missions as they appear, and finish the final one before the story moves past his arc. Stranger missions can become unavailable late in the game, so do not leave this for after the finale.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton's strand is a stranger arc — work through his missions as they appear, and finish the final one before the story moves past his arc. Stranger missions can become unavailable late in the game.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Billy's strand is a stranger arc — work through his missions as they appear, and finish the final one before the story moves past his arc. Stranger missions can become unavailable late in the game.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Strangers appear as ? markers around Leonida, and each strand is a short chain of missions. Do them as you find them — strands can lock out once the story passes certain points, so do not leave them all for after the finale.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Randy's strand is a stranger arc — work through his missions as they appear, and finish the final one before the story moves past his arc. Stranger missions can become unavailable late in the game.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's strand is a stranger arc — work through his missions as they appear, and finish the final one before the story moves past his arc. Stranger missions can become unavailable late in the game.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are marked on the map once discovered; visit each one and complete the meditation. The count is cumulative and never resets.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a one-off — track the animal when the mission starts and do not let it escape, as the hunt may not repeat. Bring a scoped rifle and follow the trail markers.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, and each set needs its full run of cards. Use the in-game collection tracker to see which sets are incomplete, then sweep the areas you are missing.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and tag activity — open it at 100 different spots around Leonida. The count is cumulative and never resets, so just use it whenever you are somewhere new.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — driving, combat, exploration — and they tick off as you play. Check the challenges menu to see which ones are close, then mop up the easy ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner (Lucia) beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Get the wanted level up, then break line of sight and hide until it clears — do not get caught. A quiet backstreet or a tunnel works well for hiding.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time. Plan a route of three nearby shops, hit them quickly, and do not lose the cops between robberies — the wanted level must stay active from the first shop to the third.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter 100 different vehicle models. A new vehicle registers when you get in it, so vary what you drive and check the vehicle collection to see what is missing. Rare spawns count the same as common ones.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus when a group is clustered, then take them down before it ends — a tight group in a firefight is the best setup. Weaker enemies go down faster, so pick your moment.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA (the airport) in an unscheduled way — steal a plane and take off without following a flight plan. Any aircraft at the airport works; get in, throttle up, and leave.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. Get a wanted level high enough that the military sends Rhinos, then survive the encounter or destroy one. A 4- to 5-star wanted level in an open area is the usual trigger.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. A stealth approach with no gunfire is the way; if you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies — plan the getaway before you go in, and escape cleanly after each one. The count is cumulative across all vaults.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; stop one, crack it, take the cash, and get away before the cops close in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each named area; check the map for the areas you have not been to yet and drive through them. A slow drive along the coast and through the countryside covers most of it.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations in its own territory; hit one per gang. The map marks gang territory, so work through them gang by gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view — the trophy pops once you are seated with the drink and the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic GTA style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass. Any vehicle showroom works; pick a fast car and aim for the window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Just complete a game of bowling there — you do not need a high score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a story beat with Lucia. It unlocks through the story; keep playing and it will come. It is tied to a specific story moment, not to anything you can grind.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count (500). Choices appear in missions and encounters; make them as you go. Because the count is high and choices are spread through the game, do not skip dialogue choices when they appear, and do not rush past optional decisions.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then succeed at it on the next attempt. It tracks a specific second-attempt success; if it has not popped, retry a challenge you failed once and clear it. Deliberately failing a short challenge once, then clearing it, is the reliable way.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a random odd event in Leonida. These events appear while exploring; keep an eye out for unusual happenings and the trophy pops when you see one. It can be easy to walk past, so explore off the beaten path.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line up a target on foot, drive past, and swing. A slow drive-by gives you the best aim.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; pass them to a contact to clean them. The total is cumulative — keep laundering as you earn, and it adds up over the game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything. The total is cumulative across all shops, so buy gear as you play and it adds up. Big-ticket items like weapons and cars move the total fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from the in-game property site; each one costs money, so save up and buy them as you can afford them. Owning them also gives you storage for your vehicle collection.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, add vehicles you have driven, and register 10 of them. Any 10 vehicles count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
